description.en: This recipe is for Honey Whole Wheat Challah, attributed to Jeff Smith. It includes instructions for preparing the dough, braiding, and baking.

ocrRawText:
Honey Whole Wheat Challah (Jeff Smith)
2c Tap Water
4 Envelopes Quick Rise Yeast
2 Tsp Kosher Salt
2 Tbsp Brown Sugar
1 Egg & 1 yolk - beaten
1/3 c Oil (peanuts)
1/2 c Honey
3c White Flour
3c Wheat Flour
Corn Meal
Egg Wash-mix
1 Egg
1 Tbsp Honey
1 Tbsp Water

① Water, yeast, salt, br. Sugar - Stir to dissolve
② Add beaten egg + yolk, oil, honey - stir
③ Add 3c White Flour + 2c Wheat Flour - beat 10 min
④ Knead in remaining flour (both 1c wheat + 1c White)
⑤ Knead for 10 min
⑥ Put in bowl, cover & allow to rise until doubles in size
⑦ Punch down & allow to rise again
⑧ Punch down again, divide in half. Divide each half into
thirds & braid. Sprinkle cornmeal on sheet pans and
place one loaf on each
⑨ Allow to rise until doubles in size
⑩ Make Egg wash & spread on top (brush on)
⑪ Bake 1hr at 350°F (preheat oven)
